The '''Gilad Pellaeon Auditorium''' was an auditorium located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], which was named after [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. In [[44 ABY]], the entire [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] and the candidates for the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|election]] were present in the auditorium for the [[Great Election Day Debate|debate]] between the candidates.<ref name="apocalypse" />
